cues.en: Hi and welcome to this AI in C# video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to look into something called AG-UI, which is the acronym for Agent User Interaction Protocol.
cues.zh: 今天介紹 AG-UI，也就是 Agent User Interaction Protocol，代理程式使用者互動協定。

cues.en: When I first saw this name I actually thought it was something to do with Autogen and their drag and drop features that have been there for a long time, but it's
cues.zh: 第一次看到名稱，我以為和 AutoGen 早就有的拖曳介面有關，但它，

cues.en: actually a new protocol that is very, very new.
cues.zh: 其實是一個非常新的協定。

cues.en: Came back in May, I think, of 2025, so it's less than six months old.
cues.zh: 印象中是 2025 年五月推出，到現在還不到六個月。

cues.en: So when I saw that and found out it's a protocol, I said, oh, not another protocol.
cues.zh: 知道它又是協定時，我第一個想法是：怎麼又來一個？

cues.en: We have MCP, we have AG-UI, we have all these different things.
cues.zh: 已經有 MCP、AG-UI，以及各種不同規格。

cues.en: But the more I looked into it, it really solves an actual problem in terms of
cues.zh: 但越研究，就發現它確實解決了，

cues.en: the UI part of AI, and it does it in quite an elegant way and a standard way that I really hope this protocol
cues.zh: AI 使用者介面的真實問題，而且做法優雅、標準化。我很希望這個協定，

cues.en: will kick on.
cues.zh: 能真正普及。

cues.en: Microsoft is embracing it, so that's a really good sign.
cues.zh: Microsoft 也開始支援，這是很好的訊號。

cues.en: But what is it?
cues.zh: 那它到底是什麼？

cues.en: When we build our small console apps here in this series, we don't have a problem.
cues.zh: 這個系列裡的小型主控台應用程式，沒有太大問題。

cues.en: We just have some consoles and we can do normal calls, we can do streaming, we can do tools and so on, but everything
cues.zh: 我們可以直接在主控台呼叫、串流、使用工具，但全部，

cues.en: happens in one process.
cues.zh: 都發生在同一個行程。

cues.en: In real life, that's not often the case.
cues.zh: 實際應用通常不是這樣。

cues.en: Of course, it can still be done, but often we have a frontend and we have a backend.
cues.zh: 當然也可以單行程，但更多時候會分成前端與後端。

cues.en: And the frontend would be the chatbot or whatever we do, and the server have the backend agent.
cues.zh: 前端是聊天介面或其他 UI，伺服器端才放代理程式。

cues.en: Of course, there's also backend systems and automated behind the scenes things without frontends, and this protocol is not for that.
cues.zh: 純後端或背景自動化系統不需要前端，這個協定就不是針對那些情境。

cues.en: But if you have this frontend, backend system, and you've tried it in real life, you know that it's quite simple, of course, to have a backend and you do a request
cues.zh: 如果做過前後端系統，就知道一般請求，

cues.en: response in order to get some information.
cues.zh: 與回應很容易實作。

cues.en: So you could have the user answer a question and get a response back.
cues.zh: 使用者提出問題，再取得回覆，

cues.en: No big deal.
cues.zh: 沒有太大困難。

cues.en: It's also easy just to couple a bunch of MCP servers, own tools and such onto the backend server and have them be able
cues.zh: 也很容易把 MCP 伺服器、自訂工具等接到後端，

cues.en: to be called so the user can just ask and the server can use its own server tools.
cues.zh: 讓使用者詢問時，由伺服器使用自己的工具。

cues.en: But where it becomes tricky is when we need to be live chat GPT and do a stream request and get a streaming response.
cues.zh: 但如果想像 ChatGPT 一樣，發出串流請求並持續接收回覆，就比較麻煩。

cues.en: Because how do you do that?
cues.zh: 該怎麼做呢？

cues.en: It is possible.
cues.zh: 當然做得到。

cues.en: I have actually done it in a sample application and also in a real application.
cues.zh: 我在範例與正式應用中都做過。

cues.en: But if you sit with some React frontend and a C-sharp backend, how do you begin to send server-side events, which it
cues.zh: 但 React 前端搭配 C# 後端時，要如何傳送 Server-Sent Events，

cues.en: is?
cues.zh: 也就是這裡使用的串流機制？

cues.en: And how do you make it scalable?
cues.zh: 又該如何擴充規模？

cues.en: How do you make it easy to work with?
cues.zh: 怎麼讓它容易使用？

cues.en: So it can be done, but it's a pain.
cues.zh: 做得到，但非常麻煩。

cues.en: Another thing is, which I have actually never thought about, what if the frontend actually have some capabilities that you want to expose as
cues.zh: 另一件我以前沒想過的事，是如果前端本身有功能，想當成，

cues.en: tools to the backend?
cues.zh: 工具提供給後端呢？

cues.en: So just like we have server tools, what if the frontend could be changed the colour of something or how something looks, and we
cues.zh: 就像後端有工具一樣，前端可能能改變顏色、調整畫面，

cues.en: wanted AI to do that?
cues.zh: 而我們希望 AI 能控制。

cues.en: I actually have really no idea without this protocol, how you could do that.
cues.zh: 如果沒有這個協定，我真的不太知道要怎麼實作。

cues.en: But that is what we can do in a very, very elegant way.
cues.zh: 但它能用很優雅的方式做到。

cues.en: And let's go in and see some code because there's actually not too much to it.
cues.zh: 接著看程式碼，因為其實不需要太多。

cues.en: So here we are in the system and we are working with this agent user interaction and we have a client and a server.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Agent User Interaction 範例，分成 Client 與 Server。

cues.en: So for that reason, I have gone up and used the multiple startup projects.
cues.zh: 因此我設定了多個啟始專案，

cues.en: So I run both the server and the client.
cues.zh: 同時執行伺服器與用戶端。

cues.en: And I will go to the server, but I will just start the code and set a breakpoint on the client here.
cues.zh: 先在用戶端設中斷點，再看伺服器。

cues.en: So let me run it and then we go quickly to the server and see what that's about.
cues.zh: 先執行，接著快速切到伺服器。

cues.en: And here we have the client UI.
cues.zh: 這裡就是用戶端介面。

cues.en: Of course, I'm still using consoles, but this could just have easily been a Blazor app that would have this problem of talking with
cues.zh: 當然仍使用主控台，但也可以很容易換成 Blazor，讓它與，

cues.en: a backend server.
cues.zh: 後端伺服器通訊。

cues.en: So what happens is we start with the normal business as usual.
cues.zh: 伺服器先照平常的方式，

cues.en: We just make a client and we make an agent.
cues.zh: 建立用戶端與代理程式。

cues.en: And in this case, I make an agent with one tool call that is called GetWeather.
cues.zh: 這個代理程式只有一個工具 GetWeather。

cues.en: And then we make a normal web application.
cues.zh: 再建立一般 WebApplication。

cues.en: So had this been a standard ASP.NET Core web UI, we have had this out of the box.
cues.zh: 如果原本是 ASP.NET Core 網站，這部分本來就有。

cues.en: And the only thing we need to really do is we need to add a AG-UI as a service, and we need to map
cues.zh: 真正需要新增的，只是把 AG-UI 註冊為服務，再映射，

cues.en: it to an endpoint.
cues.zh: 到一個端點。

cues.en: In our case, just the root of this.
cues.zh: 這個範例直接使用根路徑。

cues.en: And then we run the system.
cues.zh: 最後執行。

cues.en: And if we do that, we will see that we are just running as something here,
cues.zh: 這樣就會啟動服務，

cues.en: and we have a local host here.
cues.zh: 並取得 localhost 網址。

cues.en: In real life, it'll of course be HTTPS and over the internet instead of just a local host here.
cues.zh: 實際部署當然會使用網際網路上的 HTTPS，而不是 localhost。

cues.en: So you can see the server is nothing other than instantiating an agent and exposing it.
cues.zh: 所以伺服器只是建立代理程式，再把它公開。

cues.en: The client is also fairly simple in that we just make an HTTP client because we need to talk with the server.
cues.zh: 用戶端也很簡單，先建立 HttpClient，才能與伺服器通訊。

cues.en: And we do that over the URL we have chosen.
cues.zh: 指定剛才選定的 URL。

cues.en: Then I make something with the colour of the text here.
cues.zh: 接著設定一下文字顏色。

cues.en: Right now you can see it's white.
cues.zh: 目前是白色。

cues.en: And then I make an AG-UI chat client.
cues.zh: 然後建立 AGUIChatClient。

cues.en: So instead of a normal chat client, I make an AGUI client.
cues.zh: 也就是用 AG-UI 用戶端，取代一般 Chat Client。

cues.en: And all it needs is an HTTP client and the server URL.
cues.zh: 只需要 HttpClient 與伺服器網址。

cues.en: And once I have such a client, I can do sort of the same as I normally do using the agent part, create AI
cues.zh: 有了這個用戶端，就能像平常一樣呼叫 AsAIAgent，建立 AI，

cues.en: agent.
cues.zh: 代理程式。

cues.en: And here I can give it tools, which will be the local tools.
cues.zh: 這裡可以提供工具，也就是用戶端的本機工具。

cues.en: We also gave tools over here.
cues.zh: 伺服器那邊也提供了自己的工具。

cues.en: But suddenly we can give this proxy of an agent tools that will be handed on to the server, which is quite a cool
cues.zh: 但現在這個代理程式的代理物件，也能提供工具，並轉交給伺服器，概念非常，

cues.en: concept.
cues.zh: 有趣。

cues.en: This agent, however, is not a fully blown agent.
cues.zh: 不過這不是完整的本機代理程式。

cues.en: For example, if we give it instructions, it will not follow those instructions.
cues.zh: 例如提供 Instructions，它不會遵守。

cues.en: And that's because it's just a proxy.
cues.zh: 因為它只是代理介面。

cues.en: We can give it tools, but the rest we cannot really give because it won't follow that along.
cues.zh: 可以提供工具，但其他選項不會原樣生效。

cues.en: So it's a kind of a shell of an agent.
cues.zh: 所以比較像代理程式的外殼。

cues.en: And for that reason, for example, if we want to make an instruction, we need to give it ourself here.
cues.zh: 因此若要提供指示，需要在這裡自己加入系統訊息。

cues.en: And in the same manner, it cannot work with the threads.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這裡也不能直接使用 Thread。

cues.en: So we also need to give that on our own.
cues.zh: 所以對話歷程也要自行提供。

cues.en: This might be because it's so new a protocol, and we might at some point be able to give the instructions and the threads like normal and behind the scenes, everything would
cues.zh: 也許因為協定還很新，未來可能可以像一般代理程式，直接指定指示與 Thread，背後就會，

cues.en: work.
cues.zh: 自動處理。

cues.en: But for now, we need to do a little extra here, but trust me, it's worth doing compared to what we get.
cues.zh: 目前要多做這一點，但相信我，換來的功能很值得。

cues.en: Because what we get, and it can be perhaps a little difficult to understand if you haven't had this pain of how in the world do I get a client to talk
cues.zh: 如果沒經歷過前端要與後端通訊，

cues.en: to a server and stream the data back?
cues.zh: 還要把資料串流傳回的麻煩，可能不容易理解。

cues.en: Again, can be done, but trust me, it's damn annoying.
cues.zh: 做得到，但真的很煩。

cues.en: But in this case, we're just going in and making an agent.
cues.zh: 而這裡只需要建立代理程式。

cues.en: So if I say hi, it can come back.
cues.zh: 如果說你好，它就會回覆。

cues.en: And if we noticed there is no API keys or endpoints or anything here, there's just the URL.
cues.zh: 注意這裡沒有 API 金鑰或模型端點，只有伺服器 URL。

cues.en: And the URL can probably also be protected by normal HTTP.
cues.zh: 這個 URL 也可以使用一般 HTTP 驗證保護。

cues.en: But in our case, we don't need it.
cues.zh: 不過這個範例不需要。

cues.en: It's just an endpoint for our client to work with.
cues.zh: 它只是提供給用戶端的端點。

cues.en: So what we do is a little like we normally do.
cues.zh: 接下來的操作和往常有點像。

cues.en: The only thing is we keep track of all the messages.
cues.zh: 唯一差別是自行追蹤所有訊息。

cues.en: Instead of in a thread, we just keep them.
cues.zh: 不使用 Thread，而是自己保留。

cues.en: But then we can suddenly use streaming here.
cues.zh: 但現在就能直接用串流了。

cues.en: And streaming, yes, in one process is easy, just back to console.
cues.zh: 同一行程裡串流很容易，只要輸出到主控台。

cues.en: But here, it's actually going over HTTP and sending the server events back.
cues.zh: 但這次實際上會透過 HTTP 傳送伺服器事件。

cues.en: So if we look behind the scenes, we can actually see that there is some text event streams going on back and forward when
cues.zh: 查看背後的內容，可以看到有 text/event-stream 來回傳送，

cues.en: I wrote hello.
cues.zh: 這就是我輸入你好之後發生的事。

cues.en: So okay, we can say then, is that the only thing?
cues.zh: 你可能會問，就只有這樣嗎？

cues.en: No, it's also able to expose the different things that happens on the server.
cues.zh: 不，還能取得伺服器上發生的各種事情。

cues.en: And it does that using the different content back from the updates here.
cues.zh: 透過這裡更新中的不同 Content 回傳。

cues.en: So it can give us back the text.
cues.zh: 例如文字，

cues.en: That's what we're seeing here.
cues.zh: 就是我們現在看到的內容。

cues.en: It can give us back any function call, which we haven't made yet, any results of those function calls, and any errors that might be.
cues.zh: 也能取得函式呼叫、呼叫結果，以及可能的錯誤。

cues.en: And again, we are able to give a local tool, again, something I would never have thought about how to do in real life
cues.zh: 而且還能提供本機工具；我以前完全沒想過實務上，

cues.en: because I would just have said that's impossible.
cues.zh: 要怎麼做到，甚至可能會說不可能。

cues.en: But we can actually give this tool and on the fly when we call here, that tool is being passed onto the server, given
cues.zh: 但現在能提供這個工具，呼叫時就會自動傳給伺服器，

cues.en: as if it was something that could happen on the server.
cues.zh: 就像伺服器自己也能執行這個工具一樣。

cues.en: When the AI wants to call it, it communicates back to the client, executes the thing,
cues.zh: 當 AI 要呼叫時，協定會回頭通知用戶端執行，

cues.en: which is in our case, just change the colour, and go on its merry way to work.
cues.zh: 這裡只是改變顏色，接著再繼續工作。

cues.en: So let's see some of this in some code here.
cues.zh: 實際看看程式。

cues.en: So I could, for example, go in and say, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 例如可以問：「巴黎的天氣如何？」

cues.en: And if I do that, it should say like, not link, sorry.
cues.zh: 這裡要寫 like，不是 link，修正一下。

cues.en: And now it knows it's just a tool call and not try to find a link to the weather in Paris.
cues.zh: 現在它就知道要呼叫工具，而不是找巴黎天氣的網頁連結。

cues.en: So what it did, it made a tool call on the server, got the response back, and we could see on the client, it
cues.zh: 它在伺服器執行工具，取得結果，而用戶端也能看到，

cues.en: actually gave information on what it was doing.
cues.zh: 目前正在做什麼。

cues.en: So we can make a GUI that indicates, hey, we are calling this tool with this information.
cues.zh: 因此能建立 GUI，顯示正在呼叫哪個工具、傳入哪些資訊。

cues.en: Again, something that was very, very difficult to send using these streaming events.
cues.zh: 以前要自行透過串流事件傳遞這些細節，非常困難。

cues.en: But this is packed in, so we can do it very, very simple.
cues.zh: 現在已封裝好，所以很容易。

cues.en: And we get the result back.
cues.zh: 接著取得結果，

cues.en: And of course, that result from the tool can be used.
cues.zh: 當然也能使用工具回傳的資料。

cues.en: So we wouldn't need to write this out, but if we want to make a GUI that is very interactive and telling exactly what's going on, we can do it compared to
cues.zh: 不一定要把它輸出，但若要做互動性高、能清楚顯示進度的 GUI，現在就能輕鬆做到，

cues.en: in the past, where this was really a pain.
cues.zh: 不像以前那麼麻煩。

cues.en: In the same manner, we can go in and then call a local tool and pass it onto the server.
cues.zh: 同樣也能呼叫本機工具，經由伺服器觸發。

cues.en: So we could, for example, say, change the colour to green.
cues.zh: 例如：「把顏色改成綠色。」

cues.en: And now it did a tool call.
cues.zh: 現在發生一次工具呼叫。

cues.en: It passed the text onto the server.
cues.zh: 先把文字交給伺服器，

cues.en: The server found out it got that extra tool.
cues.zh: 伺服器知道還有這個額外工具，

cues.en: It passed that request back to the client where it ran this piece of code down here.
cues.zh: 再把請求傳回用戶端，執行下方的程式碼。

cues.en: We can set a breakpoint and say, change this colour to yellow.
cues.zh: 可以設中斷點，再說：「改成黃色。」

cues.en: So this is happening over streaming on the fly from a server.
cues.zh: 這是透過伺服器串流即時完成的。

cues.en: Again, I would have no clue how to make this with the normal HTTP.
cues.zh: 如果只用一般 HTTP，我真的不知道該如何優雅實作。

cues.en: But it works.
cues.zh: 不過它確實能運作。

cues.en: We can suddenly give client-side tools.
cues.zh: 現在就能提供用戶端工具。

cues.en: I could see desktop apps doing something directly in a system while the AI is remote.
cues.zh: 例如桌面應用程式能直接操作本機系統，而 AI 則在遠端。

cues.en: It is kind of incredible, in my mind, what this can do.
cues.zh: 我覺得這個能力非常強大。

cues.en: And the only thing that are the drawbacks is we need to keep track of the entire conversation, and we need to make the
cues.zh: 主要缺點只是必須自行追蹤完整對話，以及，

cues.en: system call upfront ourself.
cues.zh: 自己在最前面加入系統訊息。

cues.en: The rest happens quite automatically.
cues.zh: 其餘大多會自動處理。

cues.en: And again, we just get these events back so we, on the fly, can update a GUI showing how it's going.
cues.zh: 也會回傳各種事件，讓 GUI 能即時更新進度。

cues.en: So, so much pain and things I have thought about needing to do and not done
cues.zh: 過去覺得很麻煩、想做卻沒做的事，

cues.en: because it was hard can suddenly be expressed in a very, very simple way.
cues.zh: 現在突然都能用很簡單的方式表達。

cues.en: And again, we don't have any credentials here, which is also incredible.
cues.zh: 而且用戶端不需要模型憑證，這也很好。

cues.en: So as you can hear, I'm really a fan of this protocol, and I really hope it gains traction because this will make the life of us who also needs to build
cues.zh: 你應該聽得出來，我很喜歡這個協定，也希望它能普及，因為這會讓需要，

cues.en: a GUI on top of an AI much simpler.
cues.zh: 替 AI 建立 GUI 的開發者輕鬆很多。

cues.en: So with that, thank you for attending this one, and see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 謝謝收看，我們下支影片見。
